subject: Cognitive Science
title: Two Systems of Thinking
description: A micro-lesson that makes Two Systems of Thinking usable.

hook.text: What's 2 + 2? Instant. What's 17 × 24? You need to slow down and work it out. Two different systems.

buildup.text: Kahneman calls them System 1 and System 2. Fast and intuitive versus slow and deliberate.

discovery.text: System 1 runs automatically—pattern matching, gut feelings, snap judgments. It handles 95% of decisions.

twist.text: System 2 feels like 'you' thinking. But it's lazy. It often just rubber-stamps whatever System 1 suggests.

climax.text: Most errors come from System 1 answering a hard question with an easier one—and you never noticing.

punchline.text: You have two minds. The fast one usually wins.

quiz.question: Which system handles most of our daily decisions?
